Work down and keep fastballs out of the damage area against Trevor Larnach and Kody Clemens; change speeds to Larnach, whose offspeed matchup is favorable in a moderate sample. Use breaking balls and offspeed below the zone against Byron Buxton; his breaking-ball whiff rate is 34.2% in a moderate sample. If McGreevy exits early, Chris Roycroft is ready for length, with Matt Svanson behind him. Save rested setup arm Ryne Stanek and closer Riley O'Brien for late leverage.
reminders: Attack Austin Martin and Luke Keaschall.
George Soriano, Justin Bruihl, and Gordon Graceffo are limited; JoJo Romero is unavailable.

briefings.headline: Execute the approved workload and late-inning plan
briefings.message: Michael McGreevy starts against the projected right-handed Twins lineup; plan for five innings and a 90-pitch limit. Use Roycroft and Svanson for length if needed, Stanek for the highest-leverage bridge, and Riley O'Brien late. Avoid leaning on limited arms; JoJo Romero is unavailable. Keep Alec Burleson in the lineup despite the rest suggestion, along with Jordan Walker and Iván Herrera, who also have rest suggestions. The lineup faces Joe Ryan, the high-confidence projected starter; left-handed bats should look for fastballs and make him prove the breaking ball is in the zone.
reminders: Protect the limited bullpen arms where possible.
Roycroft and Svanson cover an early exit or low-leverage length.
Keep the approved lineup and starter plan.
